title: uuencode.rs: InlineUUBlock begin_length=0 sentinel is implicit contract
description: mime-tree/src/uuencode.rs: when is_encoding_problem is true, begin_length is set to 0 as a sentinel meaning 'the begin line could not be fully parsed, do not use this value'. This contract is documented in a comment, but begin_length is a public field (u32) with no type-level guarantee that it is non-zero when is_encoding_problem is false. A caller who reads begin_length without first checking is_encoding_problem will silently process a 0 as if it were a real value. The fix is either to make begin_length an Option<u32> (None when is_encoding_problem is true) or to add a method that returns the begin_length only when not an error. The sentinel-zero pattern is an implicit contract that will cause subtle bugs if a caller forgets the check.
